sys_update_xml.name: sys_security_acl_25db352cd26b4e628cc9038065bcf013
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_security_acl"><sys_security_acl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
<active>true</active>
<admin_overrides>true</admin_overrides>
<advanced>true</advanced>
<applies_to table="x_2180676_claime_0_claim"/>
<condition table="x_2180676_claime_0_claim"/>
<controlled_by_refs/>
<decision_type>allow</decision_type>
<description>Allows an employee to read only their own claims, the recorded manager to read claims awaiting their decision, and Finance approvers and administrators to read claims for review.</description>
<local_or_existing>Existing</local_or_existing>
<name>x_2180676_claime_0_claim</name>
<operation>read</operation>
<script><![CDATA[
(function aclReadClaim() {
    var me = gs.getUserID();

    // Administrators and Finance reviewers legitimately see other employees' claims.
    if (gs.hasRole('admin') || gs.hasRole('x_2180676_claime_0.admin')) {
        return true;
    }
    if (gs.hasRole('x_2180676_claime_0.finance_approver')) {
        return true;
    }

    // The claimant and the submitter.
    if (current.getValue('requested_for') == me) {
        return true;
    }
    if (current.getValue('submitted_by') == me) {
        return true;
    }

    // The approving manager recorded on this specific claim.
    if (current.getValue('manager') == me) {
        return true;
    }

    return false;
})();
]]></script>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_security_acl_8450ab8f1aee4305965950782717ac84
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_security_acl"><sys_security_acl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
<active>true</active>
<admin_overrides>true</admin_overrides>
<advanced>true</advanced>
<applies_to table="x_2180676_claime_0_claim"/>
<condition table="x_2180676_claime_0_claim"/>
<controlled_by_refs/>
<decision_type>allow</decision_type>
<description>Allows the claimant to edit only their own draft claim, and the recorded manager or a Finance approver to act on a claim under review. Field-level ACLs further restrict which fields each may change.</description>
<local_or_existing>Existing</local_or_existing>
<name>x_2180676_claime_0_claim</name>
<operation>write</operation>
<script><![CDATA[
(function aclWriteClaim() {
    var me = gs.getUserID();

    if (gs.hasRole('admin') || gs.hasRole('x_2180676_claime_0.admin')) {
        return true;
    }

    var status = current.getValue('approval_status');

    // The approving manager and Finance reviewers act on claims under review.
    // Field-level ACLs below restrict WHICH fields they may actually change.
    if (current.getValue('manager') == me) {
        return true;
    }
    if (gs.hasRole('x_2180676_claime_0.finance_approver')) {
        return true;
    }

    // The claimant may only edit their own claim while it is still a draft.
    var isOwner = (current.getValue('requested_for') == me) ||
                  (current.getValue('submitted_by') == me);
    if (isOwner && status == 'draft') {
        return true;
    }

    return false;
})();
]]></script>
<security_attribute/>
<sys_class_name>sys_security_acl</sys_class_name>
<sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_0f112ff1033d4c66a516918b184cf06e
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
<access>public</access>
<active>true</active>
<api_name>x_2180676_claime_0.ClaimEaseConfig</api_name>
<caller_access>1</caller_access>
<client_callable>false</client_callable>
<description>Reusable accessor over the ClaimEase system properties. Owns the documented threshold boundary rule so approval routing and duplicate detection always agree about which claims are small.</description>
<mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
<name>ClaimEaseConfig</name>
<sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
<script><![CDATA[/**
 * ClaimEaseConfig
 * ============================================================================
 * Thin, reusable, read-only accessor over the ClaimEase system properties.
 * Every other ClaimEase artifact (business rules, record producer, flow,
 * notifications, ATF tests) must read configuration through this class so that
 * there is exactly ONE interpretation of each setting.
 *
 * NOTHING in this application may hardcode 50, 90 or "USD".
 *
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * THE $50 BOUNDARY RULE (and how to change it)
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Two features depend on "is this a small claim?":
 *   1. Approval routing  — small claims take the PARALLEL path (Manager and
 *      Finance asked at the same time); larger claims take the SEQUENTIAL path
 *      (Manager, then Finance).
 *   2. Duplicate detection — only small claims are subject to the rolling
 *      window "one small claim per employee per N days" rule.
 *
 * The requirement describes behaviour *below* the threshold and *above* the
 * threshold but is silent about an amount exactly EQUAL to it. ClaimEase
 * resolves that boundary explicitly with a property instead of guessing:
 *
 *   x_2180676_claime_0.threshold_boundary = 'sequential'   (DEFAULT)
 *       amount <  threshold  => small  => parallel
 *       amount >= threshold  => large  => sequential
 *       i.e. exactly $50 routes Manager -> Finance (sequential).
 *
 *   x_2180676_claime_0.threshold_boundary = 'parallel'
 *       amount <= threshold  => small  => parallel
 *       amount >  threshold  => large  => sequential
 *       i.e. exactly $50 routes in parallel.
 *
 * `isParallelPath()` and `isSmallClaim()` deliberately share one comparison
 * (`_isWithinSmallBoundary`) so routing and duplicate detection can NEVER
 * disagree about which claims are "small".
 *
 * TO CHANGE THE BOUNDARY:
 *   - Change the amount  -> set `x_2180676_claime_0.approval_threshold`.
 *   - Change the currency the amount is expressed in -> `..._base_currency`.
 *   - Change the exactly-equal case -> `..._threshold_boundary`.
 *   No code change is required for any of these.
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *
 * Not client callable: all ClaimEase enforcement is server-side.
 */
var ClaimEaseConfig = Class.create()

ClaimEaseConfig.prototype = {
    /** Property namespace for this application. */
    PREFIX: 'x_2180676_claime_0.',

    /* Documented defaults, used when a property is missing, empty or invalid. */
    DEFAULT_THRESHOLD: 50,
    DEFAULT_BOUNDARY: 'sequential',
    DEFAULT_BASE_CURRENCY: 'USD',
    DEFAULT_WINDOW_DAYS: 90,

    initialize: function () {
        // Cache per-instance so a single transaction does not re-read the same
        // property dozens of times.
        this._groupCache = {}
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Low level property readers
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Reads a raw property value as a trimmed string.
     * @param {string} suffix property name without the scope prefix
     * @param {string} dflt value to use when unset/blank
     * @return {string}
     */
    _getString: function (suffix, dflt) {
        var raw = gs.getProperty(this.PREFIX + suffix, dflt)
        if (raw === null || raw === undefined) {
            return dflt
        }
        var value = ('' + raw).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '')
        return value === '' ? dflt : value
    },

    /**
     * Reads a numeric property. Falls back to `dflt` when unset or not a
     * finite number (never throws, never returns NaN).
     */
    _getNumber: function (suffix, dflt) {
        var parsed = parseFloat(this._getString(suffix, ''))
        if (isNaN(parsed) || !isFinite(parsed)) {
            return dflt
        }
        return parsed
    },

    /** Reads a boolean property. Only the literal string "true" is true. */
    _getBoolean: function (suffix, dflt) {
        var value = this._getString(suffix, dflt ? 'true' : 'false').toLowerCase()
        if (value === 'true' || value === '1' || value === 'yes') {
            return true
        }
        if (value === 'false' || value === '0' || value === 'no') {
            return false
        }
        return !!dflt
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Approval routing / threshold
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Approval threshold expressed in the base currency.
     * @return {number} defaults to 50 when unset or invalid
     */
    getThreshold: function () {
        var threshold = this._getNumber('approval_threshold', this.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD)
        // A non-positive threshold would make every claim "large" and silently
        // disable duplicate detection, so refuse it.
        if (threshold <= 0) {
            gs.error(
                '[ClaimEase] Property ' +
                    this.PREFIX +
                    'approval_threshold is not a positive number; falling back to ' +
                    this.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD
            )
            return this.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD
        }
        return threshold
    },

    /**
     * How an amount exactly equal to the threshold is treated.
     * @return {string} 'sequential' (default) or 'parallel'
     */
    getBoundaryMode: function () {
        var mode = this._getString('threshold_boundary', this.DEFAULT_BOUNDARY).toLowerCase()
        return mode === 'parallel' ? 'parallel' : 'sequential'
    },

    /**
     * Currency the threshold and the duplicate rule are expressed in.
     * @return {string} upper-case ISO code, defaults to 'USD'
     */
    getBaseCurrency: function () {
        return this._getString('base_currency', this.DEFAULT_BASE_CURRENCY).toUpperCase()
    },

    /**
     * THE single boundary comparison. Both approval routing and duplicate
     * detection call this, which is what keeps them consistent.
     *
     * @param {number|string} amountInBaseCurrency normalised claim amount
     * @return {boolean} true when the amount counts as a "small" claim
     */
    _isWithinSmallBoundary: function (amountInBaseCurrency) {
        var amount = parseFloat(amountInBaseCurrency)
        if (isNaN(amount) || !isFinite(amount)) {
            // An unknown amount is never treated as small: it must not silently
            // gain the parallel path nor silently escape duplicate detection.
            return false
        }
        var threshold = this.getThreshold()
        if (this.getBoundaryMode() === 'parallel') {
            return amount <= threshold
        }
        return amount < threshold
    },

    /**
     * @param {number} amountUsd amount already normalised to the base currency
     * @return {boolean} true => Manager and Finance in parallel
     */
    isParallelPath: function (amountUsd) {
        return this._isWithinSmallBoundary(amountUsd)
    },

    /**
     * Uses the SAME comparison as isParallelPath so duplicate detection and
     * approval routing can never disagree about which claims are "small".
     *
     * @param {number} amountUsd amount already normalised to the base currency
     * @return {boolean}
     */
    isSmallClaim: function (amountUsd) {
        return this._isWithinSmallBoundary(amountUsd)
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Duplicate prevention
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Length of the rolling duplicate window, in whole days.
     * @return {number} defaults to 90
     */
    getDuplicateWindowDays: function () {
        var days = Math.floor(this._getNumber('duplicate_window_days', this.DEFAULT_WINDOW_DAYS))
        if (isNaN(days) || days <= 0) {
            return this.DEFAULT_WINDOW_DAYS
        }
        return days
    },

    /** Exclude Cancelled (and Duplicate) claims from duplicate detection. Default true. */
    excludeCancelledFromDuplicate: function () {
        return this._getBoolean('duplicate_exclude_cancelled', true)
    },

    /** Exclude Rejected claims from duplicate detection. Default FALSE — a rejected small claim still blocks. */
    excludeRejectedFromDuplicate: function () {
        return this._getBoolean('duplicate_exclude_rejected', false)
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Submission validation policy
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /** Permit an expense date in the future. Default false. */
    allowFutureExpenseDate: function () {
        return this._getBoolean('allow_future_expense_date', false)
    },

    /** Require at least one receipt attachment before submission. Default true. */
    requireReceipt: function () {
        return this._getBoolean('require_receipt', true)
    },

    /** Allow submitting on behalf of another employee. Default false. */
    allowDelegatedSubmission: function () {
        return this._getBoolean('allow_delegated_submission', false)
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Approver resolution
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /** Name of the group whose members perform Finance approval. */
    getFinanceGroupName: function () {
        return this._getString('finance_group', 'ClaimEase Finance Approvers')
    },

    /** Name of the fallback approver / exception-queue group. */
    getFallbackGroupName: function () {
        return this._getString('fallback_approver_group', 'ClaimEase Claim Administrators')
    },

    /** Finance group approval policy: 'anyone' (default) or 'everyone'. */
    getFinanceGroupPolicy: function () {
        var policy = this._getString('finance_group_policy', 'anyone').toLowerCase()
        return policy === 'everyone' ? 'everyone' : 'anyone'
    },

    /** Service Portal URL suffix used when building employee-facing links. */
    getPortalSuffix: function () {
        return this._getString('portal_suffix', 'claimease')
    },

    /**
     * Resolves a sys_user_group sys_id from its name.
     * @return {string} sys_id, or '' when the group does not exist
     */
    _groupSysIdByName: function (groupName) {
        if (!groupName) {
            return ''
        }
        if (this._groupCache.hasOwnProperty(groupName)) {
            return this._groupCache[groupName]
        }
        var sysId = ''
        try {
            var group = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group')
            group.addQuery('name', groupName)
            group.setLimit(1)
            group.query()
            if (group.next()) {
                sysId = group.getUniqueValue()
            } else {
                gs.error('[ClaimEase] Configured group "' + groupName + '" does not exist in sys_user_group.')
            }
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[ClaimEase] Unable to resolve group "' + groupName + '": ' + e)
        }
        this._groupCache[groupName] = sysId
        return sysId
    },

    /** @return {string} sys_id of the Finance approver group, '' when not found */
    getFinanceGroupSysId: function () {
        return this._groupSysIdByName(this.getFinanceGroupName())
    },

    /** @return {string} sys_id of the fallback approver group, '' when not found */
    getFallbackGroupSysId: function () {
        return this._groupSysIdByName(this.getFallbackGroupName())
    },

    type: 'ClaimEaseConfig',
}
]]></script>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
<access>public</access>
<active>true</active>
<api_name>x_2180676_claime_0.ClaimEaseCurrency</api_name>
<caller_access>1</caller_access>
<client_callable>false</client_callable>
<description>Parses the composite currency value CODE;amount and converts it to the configured base currency, writing the result to amount_usd. Fails loudly when no exchange rate is available.</description>
<mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
<name>ClaimEaseCurrency</name>
<sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
<script><![CDATA[/**
 * ClaimEaseCurrency
 * ============================================================================
 * Converts a ClaimEase claim amount into the configured base currency and
 * writes the result to `amount_usd`, which is the ONLY field used for threshold
 * evaluation and duplicate detection.
 *
 * SAFETY RULE: a foreign-currency amount is NEVER silently treated as if it
 * were already in the base currency. If no rate can be found, every method
 * returns `ok: false` with a readable `error`, and the caller (the "Normalise
 * Amount" business rule) aborts the save / routes the claim to the exception
 * queue rather than letting an unconverted amount reach approval routing.
 *
 * The `amount` field is a currency column, stored as "<CODE>;<amount>", e.g.
 * "USD;25.0000". Parsing here is deliberately defensive and also accepts a
 * plain numeric string, an empty value and a value with no separator.
 *
 * Not client callable.
 */
var ClaimEaseCurrency = Class.create()

ClaimEaseCurrency.prototype = {
    /** Platform FX rate table (from_currency / to_currency / rate / span_start / span_end). */
    RATE_TABLE: 'fx_conversion_rate',

    /** Decimal places kept on the normalised amount. */
    SCALE: 2,

    initialize: function () {
        this.config = new ClaimEaseConfig()
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Parsing
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Pulls the raw composite currency string out of whatever the caller
     * handed us.
     *
     * @param {GlideRecord|string|number} input claim GlideRecord, or the raw value
     * @return {string} raw value, possibly ''
     */
    _rawValueOf: function (input) {
        if (input === null || input === undefined) {
            return ''
        }
        if (typeof input === 'string' || typeof input === 'number') {
            return ('' + input).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '')
        }
        // Assume a GlideRecord positioned on a claim.
        try {
            if (typeof input.getValue === 'function') {
                var fromRecord = input.getValue('amount')
                return fromRecord === null || fromRecord === undefined
                    ? ''
                    : ('' + fromRecord).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '')
            }
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[ClaimEase] Could not read the amount field from the supplied record: ' + e)
            return ''
        }
        return ('' + input).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '')
    },

    /**
     * Parses "<CODE>;<amount>" without attempting any conversion.
     * Exposed so the validator can check "amount parses and is > 0" without
     * needing an FX rate.
     *
     * @param {GlideRecord|string|number} input
     * @return {{ok: boolean, value: number, code: string, error: string}}
     *         `code` is '' when the stored value carried no currency code.
     */
    parseAmount: function (input) {
        var result = { ok: false, value: 0, code: '', error: '' }
        var raw = this._rawValueOf(input)

        if (raw === '') {
            result.error = 'Claim amount is empty.'
            return result
        }

        var amountPart = raw
        if (raw.indexOf(';') > -1) {
            var parts = raw.split(';')
            result.code = ('' + parts[0]).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '').toUpperCase()
            // Guard against a trailing separator such as "USD;".
            amountPart = parts.length > 1 ? ('' + parts[1]).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') : ''
        }

        if (amountPart === '') {
            result.error = 'Claim amount "' + raw + '" has a currency code but no numeric amount.'
            return result
        }

        // Strip grouping separators a client may have submitted ("1,250.00").
        var numeric = parseFloat(amountPart.replace(/,/g, ''))
        if (isNaN(numeric) || !isFinite(numeric)) {
            result.error = 'Claim amount "' + raw + '" is not a number.'
            return result
        }

        result.ok = true
        result.value = numeric
        return result
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Conversion
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Converts a claim amount into the configured base currency.
     *
     * @param {GlideRecord|string|number} glideRecordOrAmountString
     * @return {{ok: boolean, value: number, code: string, error: string}}
     *         `value` is the amount in the base currency when ok;
     *         `code` is the source currency code that was detected.
     */
    toBaseCurrency: function (glideRecordOrAmountString) {
        var base = this.config.getBaseCurrency()
        var parsed = this.parseAmount(glideRecordOrAmountString)

        if (!parsed.ok) {
            return { ok: false, value: 0, code: parsed.code || base, error: parsed.error }
        }

        // No code recorded (plain numeric value) => the platform stored it in the
        // base currency, so the amount is already usable.
        if (!parsed.code || parsed.code === base) {
            return { ok: true, value: this._round(parsed.value), code: base, error: '' }
        }

        var converted = this._convert(parsed.value, parsed.code, base)
        if (!converted.ok) {
            // Deliberately NOT falling back to the raw amount: see the safety rule
            // in the file header.
            return {
                ok: false,
                value: 0,
                code: parsed.code,
                error:
                    'No usable exchange rate from ' +
                    parsed.code +
                    ' to ' +
                    base +
                    '. ' +
                    converted.error,
            }
        }

        return { ok: true, value: this._round(converted.value), code: parsed.code, error: '' }
    },

    /**
     * Sets `amount_usd` on the supplied claim GlideRecord. Does NOT call
     * update() — intended for use from a before business rule.
     *
     * @param {GlideRecord} claimGr claim record being saved
     * @return {{ok: boolean, value: number, code: string, error: string}}
     */
    normalizeClaim: function (claimGr) {
        var result = this.toBaseCurrency(claimGr)
        if (result.ok && claimGr && typeof claimGr.setValue === 'function') {
            claimGr.setValue('amount_usd', result.value)
        }
        return result
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Internals
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    _round: function (value) {
        var factor = Math.pow(10, this.SCALE)
        return Math.round(value * factor) / factor
    },

    /**
     * Attempts every scoped-safe conversion route available on this instance.
     * Everything is wrapped in try/catch: if the FX tables are not readable
     * from this scope we report failure instead of guessing.
     *
     * Routes, in order:
     *   1. direct rate   from -> to
     *   2. inverse rate  to   -> from   (value / rate)
     *   3. cross rate via a shared pivot currency P, using P -> from and P -> to
     *      (the platform's seeded fx_conversion_rate data is EUR-pivoted, so the
     *      cross route is what makes e.g. GBP -> USD work).
     *
     * @return {{ok: boolean, value: number, error: string}}
     */
    _convert: function (amount, fromCode, toCode) {
        try {
            var direct = this._lookupRate(fromCode, toCode)
            if (direct !== null && direct !== 0) {
                return { ok: true, value: amount * direct, error: '' }
            }

            var inverse = this._lookupRate(toCode, fromCode)
            if (inverse !== null && inverse !== 0) {
                return { ok: true, value: amount / inverse, error: '' }
            }

            var pivots = this._pivotCurrencies()
            for (var i = 0; i < pivots.length; i++) {
                var pivot = pivots[i]
                if (pivot === fromCode || pivot === toCode) {
                    continue
                }
                var pivotToFrom = this._lookupRate(pivot, fromCode)
                var pivotToTarget = this._lookupRate(pivot, toCode)
                if (pivotToFrom !== null && pivotToFrom !== 0 && pivotToTarget !== null) {
                    return {
                        ok: true,
                        value: amount * (pivotToTarget / pivotToFrom),
                        error: '',
                    }
                }
            }

            return {
                ok: false,
                value: 0,
                error: 'No direct, inverse or cross rate exists in ' + this.RATE_TABLE + '.',
            }
        } catch (e) {
            // Typically a cross-scope read restriction on the FX tables.
            return {
                ok: false,
                value: 0,
                error: 'Currency conversion is unavailable to this application scope: ' + e,
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * @return {number|null} the most recently effective rate, or null
     */
    _lookupRate: function (fromCode, toCode) {
        if (!fromCode || !toCode || fromCode === toCode) {
            return fromCode === toCode ? 1 : null
        }

        // Preferred: a rate whose effective span covers "now".
        var effective = this._queryRate(fromCode, toCode, true)
        if (effective !== null) {
            return effective
        }
        // Fallback: the newest rate regardless of span. Still a real published
        // rate, so it is safe (and far better than treating the amount as base
        // currency), but we log it so administrators can refresh FX data.
        var latest = this._queryRate(fromCode, toCode, false)
        if (latest !== null) {
            gs.info(
                '[ClaimEase] Using the latest out-of-span exchange rate for ' +
                    fromCode +
                    ' -> ' +
                    toCode +
                    '. Consider refreshing the currency rate data.'
            )
        }
        return latest
    },

    _queryRate: function (fromCode, toCode, restrictToSpan) {
        var rateGr = new GlideRecord(this.RATE_TABLE)
        rateGr.addQuery('from_currency', fromCode)
        rateGr.addQuery('to_currency', toCode)
        if (restrictToSpan) {
            var now = new GlideDateTime()
            rateGr.addQuery('span_start', '<=', now)
            rateGr.addQuery('span_end', '>=', now)
        }
        rateGr.orderByDesc('span_start')
        rateGr.setLimit(1)
        rateGr.query()
        if (!rateGr.next()) {
            return null
        }
        var rate = parseFloat(rateGr.getValue('rate'))
        if (isNaN(rate) || !isFinite(rate) || rate === 0) {
            return null
        }
        return rate
    },

    /**
     * Currencies that act as a hub in the rate table. Discovered from the data
     * rather than hardcoded, with a conservative fallback.
     *
     * @return {string[]}
     */
    _pivotCurrencies: function () {
        if (this._pivots) {
            return this._pivots
        }
        var pivots = []
        try {
            var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.RATE_TABLE)
            agg.addAggregate('COUNT')
            agg.groupBy('from_currency')
            agg.orderByAggregate('COUNT')
            agg.query()
            while (agg.next() && pivots.length < 5) {
                var code = ('' + agg.getValue('from_currency')).toUpperCase()
                if (code) {
                    pivots.push(code)
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info('[ClaimEase] Could not derive pivot currencies, using defaults: ' + e)
        }
        if (!pivots.length) {
            pivots = [this.config.getBaseCurrency(), 'USD', 'EUR']
        }
        this._pivots = pivots
        return pivots
    },

    type: 'ClaimEaseCurrency',
}
]]></script>

<api_name>x_2180676_claime_0.ClaimEaseDuplicateCheck</api_name>
<caller_access>1</caller_access>
<client_callable>false</client_callable>
<description>Server-only duplicate validation implementing the rolling-window rule for small claims, plus the per-employee submission mutex. Reusable from the record producer, business rules, the flow and ATF tests.</description>
<mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
<name>ClaimEaseDuplicateCheck</name>
<sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
<script><![CDATA[/**
 * ClaimEaseDuplicateCheck
 * ============================================================================
 * Reusable, SERVER-ONLY duplicate validation for ClaimEase. This is the single
 * implementation of the rolling-window rule and is callable from the record
 * producer, business rules, the approval flow and ATF tests.
 *
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * THE RULE
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A claim is a duplicate when ALL of the following hold:
 *   1. The claim being validated is a SMALL claim, i.e.
 *      `ClaimEaseConfig.isSmallClaim(amount_usd)` is true. Claims at or above
 *      the boundary are returned as "not duplicate" IMMEDIATELY, so the rule can
 *      never block an unrelated claim of $50 or more.
 *   2. The same employee (`requested_for`) has an earlier SMALL claim — the
 *      category is deliberately ignored, as required.
 *   3. That earlier claim has a non-empty `submitted_on` that falls inside the
 *      rolling window. The window is computed with explicit GlideDateTime
 *      arithmetic (`addDaysUTC`) rather than relative-date query strings, so the
 *      boundary and the time zone are unambiguous:
 *
 *          windowStart = now (UTC) addDaysUTC(-duplicate_window_days)
 *          qualifying  <=>  submitted_on >= windowStart
 *
 *      The window start instant is INCLUSIVE: a prior claim submitted at
 *      exactly `windowStart` still blocks. `GlideDateTime.subtract` is used to
 *      log how old the matched claim is.
 *   4. The earlier claim's status is not excluded by configuration:
 *        - `cancelled` AND `duplicate` are excluded when
 *          `duplicate_exclude_cancelled` is true (default true);
 *        - `rejected` is excluded only when `duplicate_exclude_rejected` is true
 *          (default FALSE — a rejected small claim still consumes the window).
 *   5. It is not the record currently being validated (`excludeClaimSysId`).
 *
 * The most recent qualifying claim is returned (ordered by `submitted_on`
 * descending).
 *
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * INFORMATION DISCLOSURE
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * The friendly message only names the existing claim when the caller is
 * actually allowed to read it (`GlideRecord.canRead()` on the matched record,
 * or the caller is the employee / a ClaimEase admin). Otherwise a generic
 * message with no identifiers is returned, so a delegate or a portal visitor
 * can never learn another employee's claim numbers.
 *
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * CONCURRENCY
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * `acquireSubmissionLock()` must be called BEFORE `check()` by any caller that
 * is about to create or submit a claim. It takes a per-employee named mutex
 * backed by a UNIQUE database index (see `ClaimEaseLock`), which makes it
 * impossible for two simultaneous qualifying submissions to both pass the
 * query. The lock is released by the "Release Submission Lock" after-rule, once
 * the claim row has committed.
 *
 * Not client callable.
 */
var ClaimEaseDuplicateCheck = Class.create()

ClaimEaseDuplicateCheck.prototype = {
    CLAIM_TABLE: 'x_2180676_claime_0_claim',

    /** Lock lifetime, in seconds. Covers a save transaction without stranding locks. */
    LOCK_TTL_SECONDS: 60,

    initialize: function () {
        this.config = new ClaimEaseConfig()
        this.lock = new ClaimEaseLock()
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Concurrency helpers
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /** @return {string} the named mutex used to serialise one employee's submissions */
    lockKeyFor: function (requestedForSysId) {
        return 'claim_submit:' + requestedForSysId
    },

    /**
     * Serialises submissions for one employee. Call this immediately before
     * `check()` when a claim is being created or submitted.
     *
     * @param {string} requestedForSysId employee the claim is for
     * @param {string} ownerToken        unique per attempt (ClaimEase passes the claim sys_id)
     * @return {{acquired: boolean, reentrant: boolean, lockKey: string, error: string}}
     */
    acquireSubmissionLock: function (requestedForSysId, ownerToken) {
        return this.lock.acquire(
            this.lockKeyFor(requestedForSysId),
            ownerToken,
            this.LOCK_TTL_SECONDS,
            'ClaimEase duplicate guard'
        )
    },

    /**
     * Releases the per-employee submission lock. Safe to call when no lock is
     * held.
     *
     * @return {boolean} true when a lock was released
     */
    releaseSubmissionLock: function (requestedForSysId, ownerToken) {
        return this.lock.release(this.lockKeyFor(requestedForSysId), ownerToken)
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * The rule
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Start of the rolling window, computed in UTC with explicit arithmetic.
     * @return {GlideDateTime}
     */
    getWindowStart: function () {
        var windowStart = new GlideDateTime()
        windowStart.addDaysUTC(-this.config.getDuplicateWindowDays())
        return windowStart
    },

    /**
     * Evaluates the rolling-window duplicate rule.
     *
     * @param {string} requestedForSysId employee the claim is for
     * @param {number} amountUsd         claim amount normalised to the base currency
     * @param {string} [excludeClaimSysId] sys_id of the claim being validated
     * @return {{isDuplicate: boolean, existingSysId: string, existingNumber: string,
     *           existingStatus: string, message: string, windowStart: string}}
     */
    check: function (requestedForSysId, amountUsd, excludeClaimSysId) {
        var outcome = {
            isDuplicate: false,
            existingSysId: '',
            existingNumber: '',
            existingStatus: '',
            message: '',
            windowStart: '',
        }

        if (!requestedForSysId) {
            gs.error('[ClaimEase] Duplicate check called without a requested_for value; skipping.')
            return outcome
        }

        var amount = parseFloat(amountUsd)
        if (isNaN(amount) || !isFinite(amount)) {
            // The normalisation rule aborts the save before this point, so an
            // unparseable amount here is a programming error, not a duplicate.
            gs.error(
                '[ClaimEase] Duplicate check received a non-numeric normalised amount ("' +
                    amountUsd +
                    '"); treating the claim as not duplicate.'
            )
            return outcome
        }

        // Rule 1: the rule applies to SMALL claims only. Anything at or above the
        // boundary is released immediately.
        if (!this.config.isSmallClaim(amount)) {
            return outcome
        }

        var windowStart = this.getWindowStart()
        outcome.windowStart = windowStart.getValue()

        var threshold = this.config.getThreshold()
        var parallelBoundary = this.config.getBoundaryMode() === 'parallel'

        var claims = new GlideRecord(this.CLAIM_TABLE)
        // Same employee, ANY category.
        claims.addQuery('requested_for', requestedForSysId)
        // Rule 3: a prior claim must actually have been submitted.
        claims.addNotNullQuery('submitted_on')
        claims.addQuery('submitted_on', '>=', windowStart)
        // Rule 2: the prior claim must itself be a small claim. The SAME boundary
        // comparison as ClaimEaseConfig is applied, expressed as a query.
        claims.addQuery('amount_usd', parallelBoundary ? '<=' : '<', threshold)
        // A zero/unset normalised amount is not a real small claim.
        claims.addQuery('amount_usd', '>', 0)
        // Rule 5: never match the record being validated.
        if (excludeClaimSysId) {
            claims.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', excludeClaimSysId)
        }
        // Rule 4: configurable status exclusions.
        var excludedStatuses = this._excludedStatuses()
        if (excludedStatuses.length) {
            claims.addQuery('approval_status', 'NOT IN', excludedStatuses.join(','))
        }
        claims.orderByDesc('submitted_on')
        claims.setLimit(1)
        claims.query()

        if (!claims.next()) {
            return outcome
        }

        outcome.isDuplicate = true
        outcome.existingSysId = claims.getUniqueValue()

        // Diagnostic only - uses GlideDateTime.subtract so the window maths stays explicit.
        var ageDays = this._daysBetween(new GlideDateTime(claims.getValue('submitted_on')), new GlideDateTime())
        gs.info(
            '[ClaimEase] Duplicate small-value claim detected. Matched claim sys_id=' +
                outcome.existingSysId +
                ', submitted ' +
                ageDays +
                ' day(s) ago, window start ' +
                outcome.windowStart +
                ' (inclusive).'
        )

        if (this._callerMayIdentify(claims, requestedForSysId)) {
            outcome.existingNumber = '' + claims.getValue('number')
            outcome.existingStatus = '' + claims.getDisplayValue('approval_status')
            outcome.message = this._specificMessage(outcome, claims.getDisplayValue('submitted_on'))
        } else {
            // No claim number, no status, no dates - nothing identifying.
            outcome.message = this._genericMessage()
        }

        return outcome
    },

    /**
     * Convenience wrapper for business rules. Runs `check()`, always stamps
     * `duplicate_check`, and on a hit marks the claim as a duplicate so that no
     * eligible claim is created and no approval is started.
     *
     * Does NOT call update() — intended for use from a before business rule.
     *
     * @param {GlideRecord} claimGr the claim being saved
     * @return {boolean} true when a duplicate was detected
     */
    enforce: function (claimGr) {
        if (!claimGr) {
            return false
        }

        // Record that duplicate validation has been evaluated, hit or miss.
        claimGr.setValue('duplicate_check', true)

        var result = this.check(
            claimGr.getValue('requested_for'),
            claimGr.getValue('amount_usd'),
            claimGr.getUniqueValue()
        )

        if (!result.isDuplicate) {
            return false
        }

        claimGr.setValue('duplicate_of', result.existingSysId)
        claimGr.setValue('approval_status', 'duplicate')
        // Belt and braces: a blocked submission must never start an approval.
        claimGr.setValue('flow_started', false)
        claimGr.setValue('rejection_reason', result.message)
        claimGr.setValue(
            'exception_reason',
            this._truncate('Duplicate small-value claim within the rolling duplicate window.', 255)
        )

        return true
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Internals
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /** @return {string[]} approval_status values excluded from duplicate detection */
    _excludedStatuses: function () {
        var excluded = []
        if (this.config.excludeCancelledFromDuplicate()) {
            excluded.push('cancelled')
            // A claim already marked as a duplicate must never itself block.
            excluded.push('duplicate')
        }
        if (this.config.excludeRejectedFromDuplicate()) {
            excluded.push('rejected')
        }
        return excluded
    },

    /**
     * Is the caller allowed to be told WHICH claim matched?
     *
     * @param {GlideRecord} matchedClaim the matched claim, positioned
     * @param {string} requestedForSysId employee the new claim is for
     * @return {boolean}
     */
    _callerMayIdentify: function (matchedClaim, requestedForSysId) {
        try {
            // Primary check: record-level read access for the current user.
            if (typeof matchedClaim.canRead === 'function' && matchedClaim.canRead()) {
                return true
            }
            // The employee may always be told about their own claim.
            if (requestedForSysId && ('' + requestedForSysId) === ('' + gs.getUserID())) {
                return true
            }
            // Administrators troubleshooting the exception queue.
            return gs.hasRole('admin') || gs.hasRole('x_2180676_claime_0.admin')
        } catch (e) {
            // Fail closed: never leak on an unexpected error.
            gs.error('[ClaimEase] Could not evaluate read access for a matched duplicate claim: ' + e)
            return false
        }
    },

    _specificMessage: function (outcome, submittedOnDisplay) {
        return (
            'This claim looks like a repeat of claim ' +
            outcome.existingNumber +
            ', which was submitted on ' +
            submittedOnDisplay +
            ' and is currently "' +
            outcome.existingStatus +
            '". Only one reimbursement claim below ' +
            this.config.getThreshold() +
            ' ' +
            this.config.getBaseCurrency() +
            ' can be submitted per employee every ' +
            this.config.getDuplicateWindowDays() +
            ' days, so this claim has been recorded as a duplicate instead of going for approval. ' +
            'If this is a genuinely different expense, please contact your ClaimEase administrator.'
        )
    },

    _genericMessage: function () {
        return (
            'A similar small-value reimbursement claim has already been submitted for this employee within the last ' +
            this.config.getDuplicateWindowDays() +
            ' days. Only one claim below ' +
            this.config.getThreshold() +
            ' ' +
            this.config.getBaseCurrency() +
            ' is allowed in that period, so this claim has been recorded as a duplicate instead of going for approval. ' +
            'Please contact your ClaimEase administrator if you believe this is incorrect.'
        )
    },

    /**
     * Whole days between two instants, using GlideDateTime.subtract so the
     * arithmetic is explicit and time-zone safe.
     *
     * @return {number}
     */
    _daysBetween: function (start, end) {
        try {
            var duration = GlideDateTime.subtract(start, end)
            return Math.floor(duration.getNumericValue() / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))
        } catch (e) {
            return -1
        }
    },

    _truncate: function (text, maxLength) {
        var value = '' + (text || '')
        return value.length > maxLength ? value.substring(0, maxLength) : value
    },

    type: 'ClaimEaseDuplicateCheck',
}
]]></script>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
<access>package_private</access>
<active>true</active>
<api_name>x_2180676_claime_0.ClaimEaseLock</api_name>
<caller_access/>
<client_callable>false</client_callable>
<description>Named mutex for ClaimEase, enforced by a UNIQUE database index on the lock key so two simultaneous acquires cannot both succeed. Internal helper used by ClaimEaseDuplicateCheck.</description>
<mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
<name>ClaimEaseLock</name>
<sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
<script><![CDATA[/**
 * ClaimEaseLock
 * ============================================================================
 * A named, database-enforced mutex for ClaimEase, used to serialise claim
 * submissions per employee so that two simultaneous qualifying submissions can
 * never both pass the duplicate check.
 *
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * WHY THIS STRATEGY WAS CHOSEN (please read before changing it)
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Investigated first:
 *   - `GlideRecordLock` / `GlideNativeRecordMutex`: the platform does have
 *     cluster-wide record mutexes, but they are not part of the documented
 *     scoped-application API surface. A scoped app (`x_2180676_claime_0`)
 *     cannot depend on them: the call either fails the scope check at runtime
 *     or is silently unavailable after an upgrade. Correctness must not rest on
 *     an undocumented, non-scoped class.
 *   - `GlideRecord.setWorkflow(false)`: only suppresses business rules /
 *     notifications for an operation. It provides NO mutual exclusion and is
 *     irrelevant to this problem (it is used elsewhere in ClaimEase purely to
 *     avoid recursive rule execution).
 *   - A client-side "are you sure" check: rejected outright — the requirement
 *     is server-side enforcement across every interface (form, portal, Table
 *     API, script, flow).
 *
 * CHOSEN: a lock row in `x_2180676_claime_0_claim_lock` whose `lock_key` column
 * carries a UNIQUE index. Acquiring the lock is a single INSERT. If two
 * transactions on two cluster nodes try to acquire the same key at the same
 * instant, the DATABASE rejects one of them — the race is impossible by
 * construction rather than by lucky timing. No spin-waiting, no reliance on
 * node-local state, and it works identically for the form, the portal, the
 * Table API and server scripts.
 *
 * LOCK LIFETIME
 *   acquire() is called from the BEFORE insert/update duplicate guard, and
 *   release() from an AFTER insert/update rule. That is deliberate: the lock
 *   must still be held while the claim row commits, otherwise a second
 *   transaction could acquire the lock and run its duplicate query before the
 *   first claim became visible. `expires_on` bounds the damage if a transaction
 *   aborts between the two rules — the next acquirer reclaims the stale lock.
 *
 * Not client callable.
 */
var ClaimEaseLock = Class.create()

ClaimEaseLock.prototype = {
    LOCK_TABLE: 'x_2180676_claime_0_claim_lock',

    /**
     * Default lifetime of a lock. Long enough to cover a save transaction,
     * short enough that an aborted transaction only briefly inconveniences the
     * same employee.
     */
    DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS: 60,

    initialize: function () {},

    /**
     * Acquires the named lock.
     *
     * @param {string} lockKey      the named mutex
     * @param {string} ownerToken   identifies the holder (ClaimEase uses the claim sys_id)
     * @param {number} [ttlSeconds] lock lifetime, defaults to DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS
     * @param {string} [context]    diagnostic text stored on the lock row
     * @return {{acquired: boolean, reentrant: boolean, lockKey: string, error: string}}
     */
    acquire: function (lockKey, ownerToken, ttlSeconds, context) {
        var result = { acquired: false, reentrant: false, lockKey: '' + lockKey, error: '' }

        if (!lockKey || !ownerToken) {
            result.error = 'A lock key and an owner token are both required.'
            gs.error('[ClaimEase] ClaimEaseLock.acquire called without a key or owner token.')
            return result
        }

        var ttl = parseInt(ttlSeconds, 10)
        if (isNaN(ttl) || ttl <= 0) {
            ttl = this.DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS
        }

        // Two passes at most: the second pass exists only to retry after a stale
        // lock has been reclaimed, so this can never spin.
        for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
            if (this._insertLock(lockKey, ownerToken, ttl, context)) {
                result.acquired = true
                return result
            }

            // The insert was refused, so a row already exists for this key.
            var existing = this._findLock(lockKey)
            if (!existing) {
                // It disappeared between the insert and the read: try once more.
                continue
            }

            if (('' + existing.getValue('owner_token')) === ('' + ownerToken)) {
                // Same holder (e.g. a nested update in the same transaction):
                // treat as re-entrant and extend the lease.
                this._extendLock(existing, ttl)
                result.acquired = true
                result.reentrant = true
                return result
            }

            if (this._isExpired(existing)) {
                gs.info('[ClaimEase] Reclaiming an expired submission lock for key "' + lockKey + '".')
                this._reclaimLock(existing)
                continue
            }

            result.error = 'Lock "' + lockKey + '" is currently held by another transaction.'
            return result
        }

        if (!result.error) {
            result.error = 'Could not acquire lock "' + lockKey + '" after reclaiming a stale lock.'
        }
        return result
    },

    /**
     * Releases a lock, but only if this owner still holds it.
     *
     * @param {string} lockKey
     * @param {string} ownerToken
     * @return {boolean} true when a lock row was removed
     */
    release: function (lockKey, ownerToken) {
        if (!lockKey || !ownerToken) {
            return false
        }
        try {
            var lockGr = new GlideRecord(this.LOCK_TABLE)
            lockGr.addQuery('lock_key', '' + lockKey)
            lockGr.addQuery('owner_token', '' + ownerToken)
            lockGr.setLimit(1)
            lockGr.query()
            if (!lockGr.next()) {
                return false
            }
            lockGr.setWorkflow(false)
            lockGr.deleteRecord()
            return true
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[ClaimEase] Failed to release submission lock "' + lockKey + '": ' + e)
            return false
        }
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Internals
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * The actual mutual exclusion: the UNIQUE index on `lock_key` makes the
     * second concurrent insert fail.
     *
     * @return {boolean} true when this caller won the race
     */
    _insertLock: function (lockKey, ownerToken, ttlSeconds, context) {
        try {
            var lockGr = new GlideRecord(this.LOCK_TABLE)
            lockGr.initialize()
            lockGr.setValue('lock_key', '' + lockKey)
            lockGr.setValue('owner_token', '' + ownerToken)
            lockGr.setValue('context', this._truncate(context || 'ClaimEase submission guard', 255))
            lockGr.setValue('expires_on', this._expiryFrom(ttlSeconds))
            lockGr.setWorkflow(false)
            var sysId = lockGr.insert()
            return !!sysId
        } catch (e) {
            // A unique-index violation is an expected, non-exceptional outcome.
            gs.info('[ClaimEase] Submission lock "' + lockKey + '" is already held (' + e + ').')
            return false
        }
    },

    _findLock: function (lockKey) {
        try {
            var lockGr = new GlideRecord(this.LOCK_TABLE)
            lockGr.addQuery('lock_key', '' + lockKey)
            lockGr.setLimit(1)
            lockGr.query()
            return lockGr.next() ? lockGr : null
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[ClaimEase] Failed to read submission lock "' + lockKey + '": ' + e)
            return null
        }
    },

    _extendLock: function (lockGr, ttlSeconds) {
        try {
            lockGr.setValue('expires_on', this._expiryFrom(ttlSeconds))
            lockGr.setWorkflow(false)
            lockGr.update()
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info('[ClaimEase] Could not extend an existing submission lock: ' + e)
        }
    },

    _reclaimLock: function (lockGr) {
        try {
            lockGr.setWorkflow(false)
            lockGr.deleteRecord()
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info('[ClaimEase] Could not reclaim an expired submission lock: ' + e)
        }
    },

    /** @return {boolean} true when the lock row is past its expiry instant */
    _isExpired: function (lockGr) {
        var expires = lockGr.getValue('expires_on')
        if (!expires) {
            // A lock with no expiry is malformed; treat it as stale so it cannot
            // block submissions permanently.
            return true
        }
        var expiry = new GlideDateTime(expires)
        var now = new GlideDateTime()
        return expiry.compareTo(now) <= 0
    },

    /** @return {string} internal date-time string `ttlSeconds` from now */
    _expiryFrom: function (ttlSeconds) {
        var expiry = new GlideDateTime()
        expiry.addSeconds(ttlSeconds)
        return expiry.getValue()
    },

    _truncate: function (text, maxLength) {
        var value = '' + (text || '')
        return value.length > maxLength ? value.substring(0, maxLength) : value
    },

    type: 'ClaimEaseLock',
}
]]></script>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
<access>package_private</access>
<active>true</active>
<api_name>x_2180676_claime_0.ClaimEaseNumber</api_name>
<caller_access/>
<client_callable>false</client_callable>
<description>Issues reimbursement claim numbers (CLM0001000, ...) from the sys_number counter for the claim table. Replaces the global getNextObjNumberPadded default, which a scoped application cannot call.</description>
<mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
<name>ClaimEaseNumber</name>
<sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
<script><![CDATA[/**
 * ClaimEaseNumber
 * ============================================================================
 * Generates the `number` value for a reimbursement claim (CLM0001000, ...).
 *
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * WHY THIS CLASS EXISTS
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * The usual dictionary default for an auto-numbered table is
 *
 *     javascript:getNextObjNumberPadded();
 *
 * That does NOT work from a scoped application on this instance, and produced
 * the runtime error:
 *
 *     "getNextObjNumberPadded undefined, maybe missing global qualifier"
 *
 * The reason is that `getNextObjNumberPadded` is not a global *function* — it is
 * a METHOD on the global `NumberManager` script include, and that script include
 * is published as `access = package_private`. A scoped application therefore
 * cannot call it, qualified (`global.NumberManager`) or not. Rather than depend
 * on an inaccessible global, ClaimEase issues its own numbers from the very same
 * platform record the `autoNumber` table property created:
 *
 *     sys_number  where category = 'x_2180676_claime_0_claim'
 *                 -> prefix 'CLM', number 1000, maximum_digits 7
 *
 * Administrators keep using the standard Number Maintenance UI to change the
 * prefix, the next number or the padding; nothing here is hardcoded except the
 * last-resort fallbacks.
 *
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * CONCURRENCY
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * `sys_number.number` holds the NEXT number to issue (this matches the platform
 * convention in NumberManager.createNumberCategory, which stores 10001 after
 * issuing 10000). Issuing a number is therefore a read-modify-write.
 *
 * Two safeguards make that safe:
 *   1. After reserving a candidate, we verify no claim already carries it and
 *      re-reserve if one does (bounded retry). This closes the practical race
 *      between two simultaneous inserts.
 *   2. The `number` column has a UNIQUE index, so the database is the final
 *      arbiter: a genuine collision can never be persisted.
 *
 * If numbering cannot be resolved at all, `getNext()` returns a timestamp-based
 * fallback and logs an error, because refusing to number a claim would block a
 * legitimate submission outright.
 *
 * Not client callable.
 */
var ClaimEaseNumber = Class.create()

ClaimEaseNumber.prototype = {
    CLAIM_TABLE: 'x_2180676_claime_0_claim',
    NUMBER_TABLE: 'sys_number',

    /* Last-resort values, used only when the sys_number record is missing. */
    DEFAULT_PREFIX: 'CLM',
    DEFAULT_DIGITS: 7,
    DEFAULT_START: 1000,

    /** Bounded retry when a reserved number turns out to be taken. */
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 10,

    initialize: function () {},

    /**
     * Issues the next claim number.
     *
     * @return {string} e.g. 'CLM0001000' (never empty)
     */
    getNext: function () {
        for (var attempt = 0; attempt < this.MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
            var candidate = this._reserveNext()

            if (!candidate) {
                // The counter record could not be read or written at all.
                break
            }

            if (!this._numberExists(candidate)) {
                return candidate
            }

            gs.info(
                '[ClaimEase] Claim number "' +
                    candidate +
                    '" was already taken; reserving the next one (attempt ' +
                    (attempt + 1) +
                    ').'
            )
        }

        return this._fallbackNumber()
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Internals
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Reads the counter, issues its current value and stores value + 1.
     *
     * @return {string} the reserved number, or '' when the counter is unusable
     */
    _reserveNext: function () {
        try {
            var counter = new GlideRecord(this.NUMBER_TABLE)
            counter.addQuery('category', this.CLAIM_TABLE)
            counter.setLimit(1)
            counter.query()

            if (!counter.next()) {
                gs.error(
                    '[ClaimEase] No sys_number record exists for category "' +
                        this.CLAIM_TABLE +
                        '". Claim numbering is falling back to a generated value. ' +
                        'Re-install the application or create the Number Maintenance record.'
                )
                return ''
            }

            var prefix = '' + (counter.getValue('prefix') || this.DEFAULT_PREFIX)

            var digits = parseInt(counter.getValue('maximum_digits'), 10)
            if (isNaN(digits) || digits <= 0) {
                digits = this.DEFAULT_DIGITS
            }

            var next = parseInt(counter.getValue('number'), 10)
            if (isNaN(next) || next <= 0) {
                next = this.DEFAULT_START
            }

            // Store the following value before returning this one.
            counter.setValue('number', next + 1)
            counter.setWorkflow(false)
            counter.update()

            return prefix + this._pad(next, digits)
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[ClaimEase] Could not reserve a claim number from sys_number: ' + e)
            return ''
        }
    },

    /**
     * @param {string} candidate
     * @return {boolean} true when a claim already carries this number
     */
    _numberExists: function (candidate) {
        try {
            var existing = new GlideRecord(this.CLAIM_TABLE)
            existing.addQuery('number', candidate)
            existing.setLimit(1)
            existing.query()
            return existing.hasNext()
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[ClaimEase] Could not verify claim number uniqueness: ' + e)
            // Treat as "not taken": the UNIQUE index still protects the data.
            return false
        }
    },

    /**
     * Unique, human-recognisable fallback used only when the counter is
     * unavailable. Deliberately distinguishable from a normal sequence number
     * so administrators can spot it.
     *
     * @return {string}
     */
    _fallbackNumber: function () {
        var stamp = new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue()
        var fallback = this.DEFAULT_PREFIX + 'X' + stamp
        gs.error(
            '[ClaimEase] Issued fallback claim number "' +
                fallback +
                '" because the Number Maintenance counter could not be used.'
        )
        return fallback
    },

    /** Zero-pads a number to the configured width. */
    _pad: function (value, digits) {
        var text = '' + value
        while (text.length < digits) {
            text = '0' + text
        }
        return text
    },

    type: 'ClaimEaseNumber',
}
]]></script>
